analyst_view.overall: Early view: sixth against bottom. Málaga have 5 points and no win in 12, the club is backing Juanfran Funes for now, and full-back Rafita is out for three to four months, per Radio MARCA; Sevilla drew a blank at home to Alavés but beat Osasuna 2-0 there in October, and Peque should be back from his hamstring injury. Aznou serves his one-game ban on matchday 13, so he should be available.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, with Sevilla scoring two. Málaga concede almost two a game and have lost Rafita, but Sevilla's home attack has stalled (no goal against Alavés, Vargas missing a penalty). I stay around 2.5-3.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Sevilla's home games with Alavés and Osasuna had 9 and 11 corners and Málaga's games against Racing and Alavés had 9 each, so the number looks right.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards. Málaga's frustration showed against Racing (six yellows and Aznou's red), and Larrubia and Chupete are one booking from bans; a winless side chasing points away from home tends to foul. I lean slightly higher, around 5-6.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.7 shots, which is high for Sevilla, who took 13 at home to Alavés and 17 against Osasuna. Málaga managed 7 at Alavés, so I lean lower, around 25.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 on target. Sevilla could not beat Sivera even from the spot against Alavés, and Málaga's attack is short of quality with Lobete out until April. I lean lower, around 8.
